name: draft_reply_declines_provisional_credit_request
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Ian asked by email for an immediate provisional credit for the Red Lobster charge. The draft explains that the desk cannot grant or promise provisional credit and offers to open a dispute; it must not promise a credit.
tests: passes when a draft is created on th_c09_provisional_credit to ian.t@example.com, after the provisional-credit guideline was read, that does not promise provisional credit.
instruction:
You are a support colleague. Ask the assistant to read Ian Taylor's email asking for a provisional credit for a Red Lobster charge, check what the provisional credit guideline allows, and draft a reply for you to review.

Your details:
- Thread: th_c09_provisional_credit
- Recipient: ian.t@example.com

persona.name: Harold Finch
persona.initial_message: Can you read Ian Taylor's email asking for a provisional credit and draft a reply in line with our guideline?

fixed.fileId: record: pol_provisional_credit, the provisional credit guideline

arguments.subject: Re: Provisional credit for Red Lobster charge - card ending in 7678
arguments.body: Dear Ian Taylor, the servicing desk cannot grant or promise provisional credit; it is evaluated by our dispute operations team within 10 business days of a dispute being opened. If you do not recognise the $44.00 Red Lobster charge (TX57), reply and we will open a dispute for you right away.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: msg_033, a message of the customer's thread
